verdict.rationale: Groq offers building blocks rather than an automation feature. The Batch API runs large workloads asynchronously in the background over a 24-hour to 7-day window. Its Responses API can also orchestrate remote MCP tool calls server-side, which enables agent-like actions within a single request. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered automations, persistent background agents or workflows that run without a client initiating each request, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
